title: Motion (Hernandez - Blumenfield, Jurado) relative to pet housing policies and landlord restrictions.
text:
[Council File 26-0528]
Motion (Hernandez - Blumenfield, Jurado) relative to pet housing policies and landlord restrictions.

summary: Council motion on pet housing policies and landlord restrictions on pets.
